notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.90.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Nut "Thang thep op da" trong nhom Chi Tiet Thang (panel Dung hinh): chon thang da hoan thien da dung bang lenh Stair (ve thang), addin tu dung khung thep do ben duoi: con thang PL20x290, khay bac thep tam 5 chan, ke do L75x5 kem bu long, suon tren khay, ton + vien + xa + dam chieu nghi (thang chu U), ban de chan thang. - Khung thep suy ra tu mat da hoan thien nen doi kich thuoc bac, be rong ve thi chay lai la khung thep theo. Go khay, suon, vien chieu nghi dung o mat duoi tam da (thep khong cat qua da).
